en: Black-and-white scenic view of a small European spa town set in a hilly, forested landscape. In the middle distance stands a tall church with a slender spire rising above clustered town buildings, surrounded by trees and fields. The foreground is framed by dark tree branches and meadow. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "Bad Elster." The photo has a white border with a slightly deckled edge, typical of vintage postcards.
